verdict.rationale: Dialpad publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g., /reference/webhookslist) and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md page variants), so a browsable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of in-browser 'try it' or runnable request execution, code samples per endpoint, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
